title: Ashbury Rewards Member Tenure Recognition: Tenure Credits on Award Stays
content:
Ashbury Rewards recognises long membership with tenure credits — elite night credits — on each award stay, a completed Reward Night Rate stay credited to the membership.

**Schedule.** A member enrolled for at least two hundred and forty whole calendar months by the handling date receives two tenure credits on the award stay, a member enrolled for one hundred and twenty to two hundred and thirty-nine whole months receives one tenure credit, and a member enrolled for less than one hundred and twenty whole months receives none. The months are whole calendar months from the enrolment date on the membership to the handling date. The tenure credits are added to the night credits posted for the award stay, and they are credits the award stay is owed, never an excess over its nights stayed.

| Whole calendar months enrolled by the handling date | Tenure credits on the award stay |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 120 | None |
| 120 to 239 | 1 |
| 240 or more | 2 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical handling date of 15 March 2026)

| Enrolment date | Whole calendar months by the handling date | Tenure credits |
|---|---|---|
| 16 March 2016 | 119 | None |
| 15 March 2016 | 120 | 1 |
| 16 March 2006 | 239 | 1 |
| 15 March 2006 | 240 | 2 |
